hero.body: Japanese discipline in dialogue with Mediterranean produce and Peruvian heritage. Nikkei cuisine, every day from 1 pm to midnight.
stop.nikkei.title: Japan, Peru and the Mediterranean at one table
stop.nikkei.body: Nikkei cuisine is born from the meeting of Japanese precision and the liveliness of Peruvian cooking. At Nami we add the produce of the sea and of Barcelona's market.
stop.nikkei.team: Our team travels to Japan regularly to select produce and learn from the masters.
stop.pricing.title: You know what it costs before you sit down
stop.pricing.body: Two menus designed to be shared by two people, with the price in view from the start.
stop.produce.title: Raw fish, with total peace of mind
stop.produce.body: The salmon and tuna we serve are 100% anisakis-free, with no antibiotics or hormones. And all the soy that reaches the table is gluten free.
stop.produce.stat1.label: Anisakis-free salmon and tuna
stop.produce.stat2.label: All the soy we serve in the dining room
stop.shari.title: The rice that changes everything
stop.shari.body: Koshihikari rice, known for its aroma, dressed with red rice vinegar from a Japanese house founded in 1937. The result has a texture, flavour and colour of its own.
stop.shari.yearNote: Year the house behind our red rice vinegar was founded
stop.howItWorks.title: Your table, in three steps
stop.howItWorks.step1Body: Choose the day, time and number of guests.
stop.howItWorks.step2Body: We open every day from 1 pm to midnight. The kitchen serves until 11 pm.
stop.howItWorks.step3Body: À la carte or with a set-menu experience for two, with pairing if you fancy.

faq.title: Before you visit
faq.reachUs: Still have a question? Call us at
faq.items.what-is-nami.a: Nami is a Nikkei-cuisine restaurant at Passeig de Gràcia 24, 08008 Barcelona, between Gran Via and Passeig de Gràcia. Japanese technique meets Mediterranean produce and Peruvian heritage.
faq.items.what-is-nikkei.a: It is the cuisine born of the meeting between Japan and Peru. At Nami we bring together Japanese technique and Peruvian heritage with the produce of the sea and of the Mediterranean market.
faq.items.cost.q: How much does dinner at Nami cost?
faq.items.cost.a: You can order à la carte or choose an experience for two: Short Experience for €150 (€75 per person) or Full Experience, 11 courses, for €250 (€125 per person). The wine pairing adds €100 for two.
faq.items.raw-fish-safety.q: Is it safe to eat raw fish?
faq.items.raw-fish-safety.a: The salmon and tuna we serve are 100% anisakis-free, with no antibiotics or hormones.
faq.items.gluten-free.a: All the soy we serve in the dining room is gluten free. If you have any allergy or intolerance, call us at +34 931 27 08 15 before you come.
faq.items.gluten-free.pending: Validate the allergy wording with the restaurant.
faq.items.opening-hours.a: We open Monday to Sunday, from 1 pm to midnight. The kitchen serves until 11 pm.
faq.items.location.a: At Passeig de Gràcia 24, 08008 Barcelona, a stone's throw from Casa Milà. Book online or call +34 931 27 08 15.
faq.items.groups-events.q: Do you host groups or private events?
faq.items.groups-events.a: Yes. Email us at hola@namicrestaurant.com and we will arrange it with you.
faq.items.gift-voucher.a: Yes. We sell digital vouchers for the Short and the Full Experience, valid for 12 months and with no fixed date. The code arrives by email right away. The purchase is final and non-refundable.
gift.title: The best gift is a table
gift.body: A digital voucher to enjoy the Short or the Full Experience. Valid for 12 months, no fixed date, and it lands in your inbox right away.

legal.legal-notices.title: Legal notice
legal.legal-notices.intro: This legal notice governs the use of the website namicrestaurant.com, owned by Nami Restaurant.
legal.legal-notices.sections.1.heading: Website owner
legal.legal-notices.sections.1.body: This website, namicrestaurant.com, is operated by Nami Restaurant, with address at Passeig de Gràcia 24, 08008 Barcelona (Spain). You can contact us at hola@namicrestaurant.com or on +34 931 27 08 15.
legal.legal-notices.sections.2.heading: Purpose
legal.legal-notices.sections.2.body: The site offers information about the restaurant, its menus and experiences, table reservations, gift cards and contact channels. Access is free and implies acceptance of this legal notice.
legal.legal-notices.sections.3.heading: Access and use
legal.legal-notices.sections.3.body: You agree to use the site lawfully and not to damage, overload or interfere with its operation, or to attempt unauthorised access to systems, accounts or data.
legal.legal-notices.sections.4.heading: Intellectual property
legal.legal-notices.sections.4.body: The design, texts, photographs, trademarks and other contents belong to Nami Restaurant or its licensors. Reproduction, distribution or public communication without express authorisation is prohibited.
legal.legal-notices.sections.5.heading: Liability and links
legal.legal-notices.sections.5.body: We work to keep the information accurate and the service available, but we cannot guarantee the absence of errors or interruptions. Links to third-party sites are governed by their own terms and policies.
legal.legal-notices.sections.6.heading: Applicable law
legal.legal-notices.sections.6.body: This legal notice is governed by Spanish law. Any dispute will be submitted to the courts of Barcelona, unless mandatory consumer rules provide otherwise.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.intro: How Nami collects, uses and protects your personal data, in accordance with the GDPR and the Spanish data protection law.
legal.privacy.sections.1.heading: Data controller
legal.privacy.sections.1.body: Nami Restaurant, Passeig de Gràcia 24, 08008 Barcelona, is responsible for the personal data you provide through this website. You can write to hola@namicrestaurant.com.
legal.privacy.sections.2.heading: Data we collect
legal.privacy.sections.2.body: We collect identification and contact details (name, email, phone), reservation details (date, time, guests and notes such as allergies), gift card purchases and delivery data, account data if you create one, and technical data such as IP address, device and browsing through cookies.
legal.privacy.sections.3.heading: Why we use your data
legal.privacy.sections.3.body: We use your data to manage reservations, process and deliver gift cards, answer queries, manage your account, comply with legal and tax obligations and, where you consent, improve the website and send communications.
legal.privacy.sections.4.heading: Legal basis
legal.privacy.sections.4.body: The legal bases are the performance of a contract or pre-contract, your consent, compliance with legal obligations and our legitimate interest in keeping the service secure and improving it.
legal.privacy.sections.5.heading: How long we keep it
legal.privacy.sections.5.body: Reservation data is kept for the time needed to manage the booking and the legal periods. Purchase data is kept for tax obligations. Account data is kept until you request deletion. Cookies are kept according to the cookie policy.
legal.privacy.sections.6.heading: Who we share it with
legal.privacy.sections.6.body: We share data with Wix, which provides hosting, reservations and ecommerce services, with payment providers and with technology suppliers that act as processors. We do not sell your data. International transfers, if any, are covered by appropriate safeguards.
legal.privacy.sections.7.heading: Your rights
legal.privacy.sections.7.body: You can access, rectify, delete, restrict or object to the processing of your data, request portability and withdraw your consent at any time by writing to hola@namicrestaurant.com. You can also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency at www.aepd.es.
legal.privacy.sections.8.heading: Security and changes
legal.privacy.sections.8.body: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data. We may update this policy; the current version is always published on this page.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie policy
legal.cookies.intro: This policy explains the cookies and similar technologies used on namicrestaurant.com.
legal.cookies.sections.1.heading: What are cookies?
legal.cookies.sections.1.body: Cookies are small files that websites store on your device to remember information about your visit, such as your language or session status.
legal.cookies.sections.2.heading: Types of cookies we use
legal.cookies.sections.2.body: We use necessary cookies for the site to work (language, session, security and checkout), preference cookies and, only with your consent, analytics cookies. Third parties such as Wix or payment providers may set their own cookies.
legal.cookies.sections.3.heading: Consent
legal.cookies.sections.3.body: Necessary cookies do not require consent. All other cookies are used only with your consent, which you can give, refuse or withdraw at any time from your browser or the cookie settings.
legal.cookies.sections.4.heading: How to manage cookies
legal.cookies.sections.4.body: You can block or delete cookies from your browser settings (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). If you disable necessary cookies, some functions, such as reservations or checkout, may not work.
legal.cookies.sections.5.heading: Updates
legal.cookies.sections.5.body: We may update this cookie policy to reflect technical or legal changes. We recommend reviewing it periodically.
legal.purchase-terms.title: Purchase terms
legal.purchase-terms.intro: These terms govern the purchase and use of Nami digital gift cards.
legal.purchase-terms.sections.1.heading: Seller
legal.purchase-terms.sections.1.body: The seller is Nami Restaurant, Passeig de Gràcia 24, 08008 Barcelona. For any question about a purchase, write to hola@namicrestaurant.com or call +34 931 27 08 15.
legal.purchase-terms.sections.2.heading: Product
legal.purchase-terms.sections.2.body: We sell digital gift cards for the Nami Short Experience (€150), the Nami Full Experience (€250) or the amount selected at checkout. The card is delivered by email with a redemption code.
legal.purchase-terms.sections.3.heading: Purchase process
legal.purchase-terms.sections.3.body: Choose the amount, complete the payment on the secure Wix checkout and receive the confirmation by email. Prices are shown in euros and include VAT.
legal.purchase-terms.sections.4.heading: Validity
legal.purchase-terms.sections.4.body: Gift cards are valid for 12 months from the date of purchase, have no fixed date and are subject to table availability. They cannot be exchanged for cash and are not rechargeable.
legal.purchase-terms.sections.5.heading: Redemption
legal.purchase-terms.sections.5.body: Book by phone, email or online and mention your code. The card can cover the chosen experience or be applied to the bill; any difference is paid separately.
legal.purchase-terms.sections.6.heading: Returns and withdrawal
legal.purchase-terms.sections.6.body: As the gift card is digital content delivered immediately, the right of withdrawal does not apply once the code has been sent, in accordance with consumer regulations. Purchases are final and non-refundable, except in cases provided by law or in the event of error.
legal.purchase-terms.sections.7.heading: Loss and applicable law
legal.purchase-terms.sections.7.body: Treat the code like cash: we are not responsible for unauthorised use, so notify us immediately if you lose it. These terms are governed by Spanish law and respect mandatory consumer rights.
